messages:
tanvi: Heads-up — we're planning a small rootfs refresh for runtime images next week to remove leftover setuid helpers and enable uidshift by default. Two quick questions: 1) does the image-signer SA need any RBAC changes to talk to KMS (we currently give it kms.keys.get + storage.objectViewer), and 2) will audit logs clearly show which key was used for the cosign signature?

alex: For cosign signing you only need permission to sign with the key (kms.cryptoSign or cloudkms.sign depending on provider). Avoid giving decrypt if possible. storage.objectViewer is fine for the artifact.

sarah: Confirming alex. Also: ensure the signer SA has only the single key's signer role, not key admin. That keeps blast radius small.

tanvi: Great — @alex @sarah two follow-ups: a) our current infra automation fetches key metadata with `kms.get` — is that covered by the signer role? b) will enabling uidshift break any existing runtime permissions for sidecars?

alex: a) yes `kms.get` is separate from sign; the signer role typically includes get metadata but check your IAM bundle. b) uidshift can break any container expecting root on disk paths — mainly init sidecars that write to /var/run. We should test in staging with same FUSE mounts.

miguel: Also flag: during the last rebuild we lost image provenance links because the signer pipeline ran in parallel with the bakes. Can we gate signing until image metadata is uploaded? ops pipeline currently does parallel tasks: bake -> push -> sign.

eva: Proposed change: make signing a separate step after push with explicit artifact tag lock. Example change in the pipeline yaml:

```yaml
- bake
- push: tag: $IMAGE_TAG
- verify: wait_for: push
- sign: uses: cosign@v1 ; args: sign --key $KMS_KEY $IMAGE_URI
```

That prevents races.

opsbot: Pipeline 4832: push succeeded for runtime/base:2026-03-15-rc4. Signing step queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jen: From an audit perspective — logs will show the key resource used for sign, but we need to make sure KMS audit export is enabled to our log-retention bucket. If we don't export KMS logs, cosign entries will be visible in registry logs but not the KMS key usage details.

sarah: Good call. Add a preflight to the rollout checklist: `ensure_kms_audit_export == enabled` and `signer_sa has only signer permissions`.

tanvi: I'll update the RFC and add those checklist items. One more small ask: for the RBAC change, can we use a dedicated signer SA per environment (staging/prod) so we can revoke a single pool without touching deployer SA?

alex: Yes please. Per-env SA + per-env key is the least risky. Also add a short rotation window for the key with a playbook for emergency rollback.

miguel: For the staging test run, I can schedule a canary bake for tomorrow 10am PT. Need approvals: @jen for audit coverage, @sarah for RBAC review, @alex for pipeline change.

jen: Approved for staging canary assuming KMS audit export configured and the pipeline uses the artifact lock.

sarah: I'll review RBAC changes this afternoon.

eva: I'll open the PR with the pipeline change and add the new `wait_for` step.

tanvi: Thanks all — I'll post the updated RFC link in this thread once it's live. :thumbsup:
